guide_zh.overview: The Frontend Stack for Agents & Generative UI. React, Angular, Mobile, Slack, and more.  Makers of the AG-UI Protocol

readme.markdown:
**[Docs](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/?ref=github_readme)** · **[Examples](https://www.copilotkit.ai/examples?ref=github_readme)** · **[Intelligence](https://www.copilotkit.ai/copilotkit-intelligence?ref=github_readme)** · **[OpenBot](https://github.com/CopilotKit/OpenBot)** · **[Discord](https://discord.gg/6dffbvGU3D?ref=github_readme)**



**CopilotKit is the open-source stack for putting AI agents in front of real users.** Bring the agent you already built, on any framework, and give it chat, generative UI, shared state, and human-in-the-loop in React, Angular, Vue, React Native, Slack, and Microsoft Teams. When it goes to production, add **CopilotKit Intelligence** and your agents keep getting better: conversations that pick up where users left off, memory across sessions, and **Continual Learning** that turns real use into Skills you review and publish. We're also the team behind **[AG-UI](https://github.com/ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui)**, the open Agent–User Interaction protocol adopted by Google, Microsoft, AWS, LangChain, Mastra, PydanticAI, and more. ## What's new | What's new | What it is | | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | 🪁 **[CopilotKit Soar](https://www.copilotkit.ai/soar?ref=github_readme)** | AI coworkers your company owns, running on your own servers. Powered by OpenBot. **[Now in early access →](https://intelligence.copilotkit.ai/?early_access=soar&ref=github_readme)** | | 🔁 **[Continual Learning](https://www.copilotkit.ai/clif?ref=github_readme)** | Agents learn from full-stack trajectories (what the agent did _and_ what your users did), captured over AG-UI. | | 🤖 **[OpenBot](https://github.com/CopilotKit/OpenBot)** | Open-source AI coworkers that each get a computer of their own. MIT licensed. | | 🧩 **[AG-UI 1.0](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/agentic-protocols/ag-ui?ref=github_readme)** + **[A2UI 1.0](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/generative-ui/a2ui?ref=github_readme)** | CopilotKit now speaks AG-UI 1.0 and the A2UI 1.0 spec for declarative generative UI. | | 💬 **[Channels](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/slack?ref=github_readme)** | Write Channels JSX once. Render native Block Kit in Slack and Adaptive Cards in Microsoft Teams. | Full changelog in **[What's New](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/whats-new?ref=github_readme)**. ## Quick start **Let your coding agent do it.** Paste this prompt into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or any coding agent running in your project. It inspects your app and walks you through the integration. ```text Help me get started with CopilotKit. From the root of my project, run this command and follow the instructions: npx --yes copilotkit@latest onboard start ``` **Start a new project.** Scaffolds a fresh app in its own directory. It won't touch an app you already have. ```bash npx copilotkit@latest create ``` **Give your coding agent CopilotKit skills.** Helps it build features and debug issues once you're set up ([learn more](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/build-with-agents?ref=github_readme)). ```bash npx copilotkit@latest skills install ```
Prefer to wire it up by hand? Here's a Next.js app in three files.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4af4c22a-1638-4328-add7-ede088afea64 ## How it works Your agent handles reasoning and execution. CopilotKit turns its work into a product experience. Events stream over **AG-UI**, so the agent can show its work as it happens, read what the user is looking at, call tools that render UI, and pause for a person to approve the next step. Your agent logic stays the same on every surface. ## What you can build https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/72b7b4f3-b6e7-460c-a932-5746fe3c8db3 | Feature | What it does | | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | | **[Chat components](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/prebuilt-components?ref=github_readme)** | Start with a working chat, replace the parts you need with slots, or go fully Headless UI. | | **[Generative UI](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/concepts/generative-ui-overview?ref=github_readme)** | Agents render real UI, from your own components to A2UI specs to sandboxed MCP Apps. | | **[Shared state](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/shared-state?ref=github_readme)** | One state layer that both the agent and your UI read and write in real time. | | **[Human-in-the-loop](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/human-in-the-loop?ref=github_readme)** | Agents pause for input, confirmation, or edits before they act. | | **[Voice](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/voice?ref=github_readme)** and **[WebMCP](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/webmcp?ref=github_readme)** | Talk to your agent, and expose your app's actions to browser agents. | | **[Inspector](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/inspector?ref=github_readme)** | A localhost overlay that shows threads, agents, and learning as you build. | ### Full control with `useAgent` Every component is built on hooks you can use directly. `useAgent` sits right on top of AG-UI and gives you programmatic control of the agent connection. ```tsx import { useAgent } from "@copilotkit/react-core/v2"; function CityPicker() { const { agent } = useAgent({ agentId: "my_agent" }); return (

{agent.state.city}

); } ``` More in the [programmatic control docs](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/programmatic-control?ref=github_readme). ### Generative UI, three ways https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3cfacac0-4ffd-457a-96f9-d7951e4ab7b6 | Type | The agent… | Built on | | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------- | | **[Controlled](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/concepts/generative-ui-overview?ref=github_readme)** | picks from components you registered | AG-UI tool calls and state | | **[Declarative](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/generative-ui/a2ui?ref=github_readme)** | describes UI as a structured spec your app renders | A2UI | | **[Open-ended](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/generative-ui/mcp-apps?ref=github_readme)** | ships a full interface that runs in a sandbox | MCP Apps | Want to go deeper? The [Generative UI educational repo](https://github.com/CopilotKit/CopilotKit/tree/main/examples/showcases/generative-ui) walks through all three. ## Works with your stack One agent backend. Agent](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/quickstart?ref=github_readme). ## CopilotKit Intelligence Most agents plateau at launch quality. **CopilotKit Intelligence** is the production layer that keeps yours improving. It works with the CopilotKit app and agent framework you already run, cloud-hosted or self-hosted on your own infrastructure. - **[Continual Learning](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/learning?ref=github_readme)**: real use of your app becomes evidence-backed insights, then Skills you review and publish. Every learned behavior traces back to its source. - **[AG-UI Streams](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/threads?ref=github_readme)**: conversations pick up where users left off, with messages, generative UI, and live runs restored as they were. - **[User Memories](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/intelligence/memories?ref=github_readme)**: durable facts and preferences carried across conversations, recalled semantically. - **[Product Analytics](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/intelligence/analytics?ref=github_readme)**: see what users ask for, what agents do, and where people get value. - **[Channels](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/intelligence/channels?ref=github_readme)**: Slack and Microsoft Teams infrastructure for the agent you already built. - **[Self-hosted](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/intelligence/self-hosting?ref=github_readme)**: the same platform inside your Kubernetes cluster, VPC, or air-gapped environment. The Developer plan is free. 👉 **[Connect Intelligence in 5 minutes →](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/intelligence/quickstart?ref=github_readme)** · [Compare open source and Intelligence](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/concepts/oss-vs-enterprise?ref=github_readme) ## AI coworkers, built on CopilotKit We build real products on this stack, and open-source them. **[OpenBot](https://github.com/CopilotKit/OpenBot)** is an open-source agent workspace for your employees. Every AI coworker gets a computer of its own, with a browser, files, and tools, and every action is decided before it happens and recorded after. Bring any AG-UI agent and any model. **[CopilotKit Soar](https://www.copilotkit.ai/soar?ref=github_readme)** turns that core into one business-ready product. It gives each employee an AI coworker that works in your company's tools, learns new tasks from the people it works with, and runs on your own servers. Our engineers set it up with you, then hand you the keys. Soar is in early access today. 👉 **[Get early access →](https://intelligence.copilotkit.ai/?early_access=soar&ref=github_readme)**

## AG-UI: the Agent–User Interaction protocol AG-UI is the open, event-based protocol that connects agents to the people using them. MCP connects agents to tools, A2A connects agents to each other, and AG-UI connects them to your users. CopilotKit is built on it, and it has first-party integrations across LangChain, CrewAI, Mastra, PydanticAI, Google ADK, AWS, Microsoft, and more. ```bash npx create-ag-ui-app my-agent-app ``` 👉 **[Explore AG-UI on GitHub →](https://github.com/ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui)** ## Community **[Discord](https://discord.gg/6dffbvGU3D?ref=github_readme)** · **[Docs](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/?ref=github_readme)** · **[X](https://x.com/copilotkit)** · **[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/copilotkit/)** · **[Blog](https://www.copilotkit.ai/blog?ref=github_readme)** ## Contributing Thanks for your interest in contributing to CopilotKit! 💜 We value every contribution, whether it's code, docs, a demo app, or spreading the word. - **Code:** start with [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md). - **Docs:** see the [docs contribution guide](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/contributing/docs-contributions?ref=github_readme). - **Not sure where to start?** [Join our Discord](https://discord.gg/6dffbvGU3D) and we'll help you find something. ## License The source code in this repository is available under the [MIT License](./LICENSE).
